thing-type.label: TailWind iQ3
thing-type.description: TailWind iQ3 smart garage controller, for up to three garage doors

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: IP address or host name of the controller, for example 192.168.1.50 or tailwind-30aea4801880.local

parameter.name: token
parameter.label: Local Control Key
parameter.description: The 6-digit Local Control Key of the controller, from the TailWind web dashboard

parameter.name: door1PartialOpenTime
parameter.label: Door 1 Partial Open Time
parameter.description: Time the door runs when it is opened partially

parameter.name: door2PartialOpenTime
parameter.label: Door 2 Partial Open Time
parameter.description: Time the door runs when it is opened partially

parameter.name: door3PartialOpenTime
parameter.label: Door 3 Partial Open Time
parameter.description: Time the door runs when it is opened partially

channel-type.label: Night Mode
channel-type.description: ON when night mode is enabled in the TailWind app. In night mode the controller closes the doors automatically during the hours set in the app.

channel-type.label: LED Brightness
channel-type.description: Brightness of the status LED of the controller

channel-type.label: Wi-Fi Signal Strength
channel-type.description: Strength of the Wi-Fi signal the controller receives

channel-type.label: Server Connection Monitoring
channel-type.description: When ON, the controller reboots itself if it loses its connection to the TailWind cloud server. Turn OFF to use the controller on a network without internet access. Requires firmware 10.61 or later.

channel-type.label: Command
channel-type.description: Sends a support command to the controller

channel-type.label: Status
channel-type.description: Whether the door is open or closed

channel-type.label: Control
channel-type.description: Opens, partially opens or closes the door. The state is the current status of the door.

channel-type.label: Locked
channel-type.description: ON when the controller has locked the door, so that it does not accept commands

channel-type.label: Disabled
channel-type.description: ON when the door is disabled in the TailWind app
